Revalidated 2026-10-20 against the Debian tracker and the unchanged runtime paths: bookworm remains listed as vulnerable without a fixed 3.0 package. This advisory requires suspended OpenSSL DTLS handshake writes and DTLS retransmission. The API exposes Node TCP HTTP/TLS and Prisma PostgreSQL TCP, PostgreSQL uses TCP TLS, and Caddy uses Go TLS; no application or deployment path enables OpenSSL DTLS. Retain only this exact CVE exception through 2026-10-31 and reassess patched bookworm/distroless availability before expiry. Other OpenSSL findings remain scanned. Sources: https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20260929.txt and https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-84782
